messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing internal RN for release v1.24. EU window 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC. Need: ops pin, short staff blast, and deploy-bot schedule. Anyone take pin+monitor?

sam: I can own rollback/runbook. tagging @lee for ops lead and oncall.

lee: Happy to lead ops. Confirming pins: runtime=0.9.3 and model default redwood-neo-1.1-q8 for EU only? Also note the quant toggle change needs a one-line FYI.

maya: Correct on both. RN should include small note: "Quant toggle applied for EU (no user-facing change)" and a "What to watch" item for KV cache warmup (first 5-10m).

natalie: Draft RN preview: https://redwood.internal.preview/1.24/embed-snippet — headline suggestion: "Faster inference, lower cost — EU rollout". I'll trim copy for staff blast.

maya: Love it. Keep staff blast ultra-short. Suggested staff blast: "Heads-up: v1.24 EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. Runtime 0.9.3. Model pin: redwood-neo-1.1-q8 (EU). Expect brief cache warmup. Oncall: lee, sam. Full notes: <doc>"

sam: Rollback thresholds proposed: p99 latency > 250ms sustained 10m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m → rollback to runtime-0.9.2. Manual rollback if eval detects quality regression. I'll add to runbook.

lee: I'll push route policy to pin model default for EU and set canary split 10/90. Will post config id when done.

ops: Route policy applied. cfg id cfg-eu-20260322-17. Canary split set to 10%. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24. Adding short alert set.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduling deploy -> prod | env=eu-prod | version=runtime-0.9.3 | start=2026-03-22T00:30:00Z | canary=10% | auto-rollforward=false | notify=#eng-releases :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary started 2026-03-22T00:30:30Z — canary=10% traffic. Metrics snapshot: p95=120ms, p99=190ms, error_rate=0.08%. Monitoring: https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24

lee: Canary looks healthy. I'll watch 30m and 1h checks and update here.

maya: Planning to post staff blast at 00:35 UTC. Natalie — can you queue the channel post?

natalie: Posted to staff channel at 00:35 UTC. Also updated RN header with contact list: lee (ops lead), sam (release owner), eng-sre oncall, docs (natalie).

ops: Alerting rule added: 2m digest to #eng-releases and direct pings to oncall if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: Status update 2026-03-22T00:58:30Z — canary steady, no anomalies detected :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for any post-canary notes.

lee: If anything pops, I'll call for rollback and notify via this thread.
